name: Julius Belkisk Harway
original_name: ユリウス・ベルキスク・ハーウェイ
source:
A participant in the Holy Grail War. 

He is a cold-hearted killer, and his role in the war is to ensure the victory of his younger brother, Leo. 

His servant is Assassin.
